title: Goal images are private to their owner
risk: Risk 2: cross-User access to stored files
shows: A goal image is served only to its owner through a short-lived signed link, and non-image uploads are rejected by content, not by name.
limits: Local storage bucket; signed-link expiry was read from the URL, not waited out.

checks.label: Owner can upload a real image
Owner gets a signed, short-lived link
checks.detail: GET as A → 307, signed URL: true, token: true
